title: Ending sounds: n, m, ng, y, w
pedagogy: Practise nasal and glide endings, including ร ล ญ changing to n. Contrast starts and endings and distinguish vowel components from final consonants.

exercises.title: ร and ล become n at the end
body: ร starts รส with r, and ล starts ลด with l. As syllable endings, both letters are pronounced n.
การ and กาล are both pronounced kan. Their spelling and meaning differ, but their ending sound is the same.
The usual n-ending spellings are น ณ ญ ร ล ฬ. Do not pronounce a final ร as r or a final ล as l.

exercises.question: What sound does ร make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ร starts รส with r. The ending ส is t.

exercises.question: What sound does ร make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ร ends การ with n. Compare ร at the start of รส, where it sounds r.

exercises.question: What sound does ล make at the start of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ล starts ลด with l. It would sound n at the end of a syllable.

exercises.question: What sound does ล make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ล ends กาล with n. การ and กาล share the pronunciation kan.

exercises.title: ญ: y at the start, n at the end
body: ญ has y as its starting sound, but n as its ending sound.
In บุญ, meaning merit, ญ is final: bun, not buy.
น and ณ also end syllables with n; ง and ม retain their ng and m sounds.

exercises.question: What sound does ญ make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ญ ends บุญ with n. This differs from its starting sound y.

exercises.question: What sound does น make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: น ends กิน with n. Its basic sound stays n in both starting and ending positions.

exercises.question: What sound does ม make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ม ends สาม with m: close your lips while the voiced sound continues through the nose.

exercises.question: What sound does ง make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ง ends สอง with ng. Do not add a separate g sound or a vowel afterwards.

exercises.title: ย and ว can end with a glide
body: When ย and ว are syllable-final glides, the vowel moves smoothly into a y-like or w-like ending. They do not create another syllable.
ขาย ends in ย, giving the ai glide. ข้าว ends in ว, giving the ao glide. This course labels those ending sounds y and w.
These letters can also be pieces of vowel spellings: ย in เ◌ีย and ว in ◌ัว belong to the vowel pattern. Identify the whole vowel before deciding a letter is a final consonant.

exercises.question: What sound does ย make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ย ends ขาย with a y glide after the vowel. Unlike ญ, final ย does not become n.

exercises.question: What sound does ว make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ว ends ข้าว with a w glide. Keep it within the same syllable without adding another vowel.

exercises.title: Eight ending sounds to listen for
body: Pronounced written consonant endings fall into eight basic sound groups: k, t, p, ng, n, m, y, w.
The first three stop the airflow. The other five are nasal sounds or glides. These groups will help with the live/dead distinction in the next unit.
Ask which syllable the letter belongs to, whether it is pronounced, and whether it is part of a vowel spelling. More complex words need cluster, silent-letter, and vowel rules too.

exercises.question: What sound does บ make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: บ ends สิบ with p. This is a stop ending, unlike nasal m.

exercises.question: What sound does ด make at the end of this syllable?
exercises.explanation: ด ends แปด with t. Its ending sound differs from its starting sound d.
